meaning.en: A form of insurance in which a person insures property for less than its full value and agrees to be responsible for the difference.

meaning.en: A sum of money paid by a patient to a health care provider after a health insurance company has paid a contractual amount for a covered service, usually a fixed percentage of costs. Coinsurance usually applies after an annual deductible has been paid.
